system.description:
Requirements: Training (1) in Subterfuge

You have especially deft hands.

  • You know a variety of tricks you can use to create a distraction, such as dancing a coin across your knuckles, or making a small object appear to disappear.

  • You have Advantage on checks to steal or hide small objects.

  • You have Advantage on checks to cheat at cards or other games of chance, provided it is possible to do so.
